captions.detailed: This 3D model consists of three separate flat-printable parts designed to assemble into a cylindrical drawer insert: a large flexible rectangular sheet and two semi-circular end caps. The rectangular sheet features a series of parallel linear ribs across its surface to allow it to wrap into a cylinder, bounded by rounded end ribs on the outer edges. The two matching end caps are semi-circular discs with raised concentric ridges, designed to slot onto the ends of the rolled sheet, with one cap featuring a small rectangular cutout at its base.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric, 3D-printable drawer insert designed to fit inside a toilet paper roll. The design must include a flexible ribbed base sheet that can roll into a cylinder, and two matching semi-circular end caps, with adjustable parameters for the inner diameter of the roll, length of the roll, base layer thickness, and end-cap side thickness.
captions.factory: The code generates the drawer parts using three main modules: base(), ribs(), and front(). The base() module creates a thin rectangular sheet with a raised reinforcement border using 'cube' primitives and 'difference'. The ribs() module generates multiple parallel linear support ribs across the sheet using a 'for' loop of 'cube' elements, while endribs() adds cylindrical edges using 'cylinder' and 'rotate'. The front() module creates the semi-circular end caps by performing 'difference' operations on concentric 'cylinder' shapes and 'cube' masks to establish the interlocking walls and a flat bottom edge.
